# Which supplier prices quietly went up, and what does it cost you?

> Free supplier price creep checker for restaurants, cafes and shops: paste invoice lines, see which items crept up, which invoice was a one-off overcharge, what it costs a year, and a credit-request email. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
